Microstrategy may be a business intelligence tool for reporting purpose where users can ready to analyze their business easily using Microstrategy reports and during this course will teach you report creation, Dashboard/Document creation and their dependents .you will find out how to enhance report performance using VLDB settings and also will teach you about project installation, DB instance creation User group creation and users creation.
